Per Morawski's own oświadczenie majątkowe (bip.bogatynia.pl, filed 19.04.2023, "na dzień 31.12.2022"), he became Radny Rady Miejskiej w Bogatyniu on 21.11.2018 — i.e. VIII kadencja, exactly as the koryta record has it. But his Rada Nadzorcza seat at Bogatyńskie Wodociągi i Oczyszczalnia (KRS 0000046613) ran 2011-02-04 to 2015-03-05, ending 3.5 years BEFORE he became a councillor. There is no overlap between the council seat and the water-utility board seat at all. The only genuine overlap is a ~3.5-month window with the DAWG seat (KRS 0000213275, ended 2019-03-06) — the seat the analyst's own report flags as having the weaker identity corroboration. 2. THE COMMITTEE-CHAIR CLAIM does not check out. Both of his sworn declarations on file at BIP (2023, for 2022; and 2024, for 29.02.2024 — the second filed as he left office) list his function under "miejsce zatrudnienia, stanowisko lub funkcja" as "Radny Rady Miejskiej w Bogatyniu, od 21.11.2018 wiceprzewodniczący Rady" (vice-chairman of the whole Council) — not chairman of the komisja rewizyjna. A site-wide BIP search for "Morawski" returns exactly these same two documents and nothing else (no resolution appointing him to lead any committee). If he is being confused with the council's actual vice-chairmanship, that's still a real, citable elected office (category C) — just not the one in the dossier, and it doesn't support the "oversight committee chair with a conflict of interest on the water board" framing that is the whole point of the headline. 3. THE SOURCE THAT WOULD FIX #1 AND #2 — "a January 2015 local press item [bogatynia.info.pl] that also identifies him as a PSL-list Bogatynia radny and chairman of the city council's komisja rewizyjna" — could not be located. Web search budget was exhausted this session; the live site's search endpoint 500-errors; and an archive.org CDX pull of every bogatynia.info.pl URL captured 2013–2017 (14,668 rows) contains zero URLs mentioning "morawski," including in the January–February 2015 window specifically (only 4 captures total in that window, none about him). That leaves the load-bearing claim — that he was already a sitting radny and rewizyjna-chair back in 2015, concurrent with the Wodociągi seat — entirely unsourced. What DOES hold up: he is genuinely "Ryszard Morawski," b. 1959-03-21 per his own BIP declaration; rejestr.io's profile for the same person (id 742685, "ur. 21 marca," the exact day/month koryta's own rejestrIo link points to) shows only 3 total KRS affiliations ever (1 current unrelated association since 2010, 2 historical — consistent with exactly the two board seats in koryta's posady field), which is decent identity corroboration for the KRS side. He is confirmed absent from the 2024-2029 council roster (bogatynia.esesja.pl). Both KRS seats are genuine rada_nadzorcza (not rada_spoleczna) at genuinely publicly-owned companies, and neither is currently 'nadal'. So there is a real, citable person with a real elected office (radny + wiceprzewodniczący Rady, VIII kadencja, 2018-2024) and a real earlier board seat (Wodociągi RN, 2011-2015) — but they never overlapped, and the specific "oversight-committee chairman" hook is not supported by any source I could open. This would not survive a complaint: the cited primary document, once actually read, contradicts the printed claim.
